description: This file appears to be a shell script for testing the functionality of git-diff, including creating blobs, comparing them by sha1 and path, and checking various diff properties.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Runs 'git diff' with full index to output differences to a file named 'diff'.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains the expected index line for given SHA-1s.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Verifies if the diff shows the expected mode changes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Checks if the diff shows the expected path changes.
